questions.answer: A binary tree is a tree data structure in which each node has at most two children.

questions.answer: Multiple inheritance allows a class to inherit from more than one parent class.

questions.answer: Cohesion measures how closely related the responsibilities of a module or class are.

questions.question: What is Shortest Remaining Time First (SRTF)?
questions.answer: SRTF is the preemptive version of SJF where the process with the shortest remaining execution time is selected.

questions.question: What is the difference between a mutex and a semaphore?
questions.answer: A mutex has ownership and can only be unlocked by the thread that locked it, whereas a semaphore does not have ownership restrictions.

questions.answer: An IP address identifies a device logically on a network, while a MAC address identifies network hardware physically.
